title: Data Modeler
description:
**About the Role**

**As a** **Data Modeler at TVH****, you will play a central role in shaping how our global organization structures, understands, and leverages its data. Operating across** **all core business domains** **(e.g., Customer, Supplier, Item, Product, Equipment, HR, Finance, Commercial, Operations, …), you will design, develop, and maintain high\-performing Logical Data Models (LDM) and Physical Data Models (PDM) that power enterprise reporting, analytics, and operational applications.**

**You will translate diverse cross\-domain business requirements into clear, standardized, and scalable data structures. Working closely with Domain Architects, Data Engineers, and Data Stewards, you will ensure our logical abstractions align perfectly with business reality while our physical implementations maximize database performance and data accessibility.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Enterprise Logical \& Physical Data Model Design:**


	+ **Design, construct, and maintain normalized Conceptual and** **Logical Data Models (LDM)** **across all enterprise domains, establishing clear entities, attributes, relationships, and business definitions.**
	+ **Translate LDMs into optimized** **Physical Data Models (PDM)** **tailored for target database platforms, balancing storage efficiency, index strategies, and query performance.**
	+ **Reverse\-engineer legacy source systems and translate complex domain requirements into normalized, reusable data structures.**
	+ **Produce and manage comprehensive data documentation, including ERDs (Entity\-Relationship Diagrams), data dictionaries, and data mapping lineage.**
* **Domain Alignment \& Standards Governance:**


	+ **Drive consistent data modeling standards, naming conventions, and design patterns across all domain modeling initiatives.**
	+ **Partner with Data Governance teams to incorporate standardized business glossaries and enterprise metadata standards directly into model structures.**
	+ **Conduct data model reviews with technical and business teams to ensure cross\-domain consistency and avoid data duplication.**
* **Cross\-Functional Technical Collaboration:**


	+ **Work hand\-in\-hand with Domain Architects to ensure domain models fit seamlessly into TVH’s target data architecture strategy.**
	+ **Collaborate with Data Engineers to guide the physical realization of models and support optimized ETL/ELT pipeline design.**
	+ **Partner with Data Analysts, Data Stewards and Business Partners to validate logical assumptions, clarify business logic, and refine domain models as needs evolve.**
* **Model Optimization \& Quality:**


	+ **Profile source data using SQL to uncover structural edge cases and validate cardinality before finalizing logical designs.**
	+ **Refine physical schemas for cloud data warehouses, adjusting partitioning, clustering, and denormalization strategies to meet performance SLAs.**

**Qualifications**

* **5\+ years of hands\-on experience** **focused specifically on Logical Data Modeling (LDM) and Physical Data Modeling (PDM) across multiple business domains.**
* **Deep expertise in diverse modeling paradigms: Relational/Entity\-Relationship (3NF), Dimensional Modeling (Star/Snowflake), and Denormalization concepts.**
* **Strong proficiency in** **SQL** **for deep source system profiling, data mapping, and schema validation.**
* **Hands\-on experience with modern** **cloud data warehouses** **(preferably** **GCP BigQuery****, Snowflake, or Databricks) and relational database platforms.**
* **Proficiency with enterprise data modeling tools (e.g., Erwin, PowerDesigner, SqlDBM, or similar).**
* **Solid understanding of Data Warehousing principles, metadata management, and ETL/ELT architecture.**
* **Fluent in English with excellent communication skills to articulate complex logical structures to both business stakeholders and engineering teams.**

**Preferred Skills**

* **Experience with** **Data Vault 2\.0** **modeling methodologies for enterprise scale.**
* **Exposure to real\-time or streaming data modeling patterns (Event\-driven architectures).**
* **Understanding of data privacy impact on data design (e.g., handling PII attributes across global domains).**
* **Experience working in Agile/Scrum distributed software delivery teams.**

title: Human Resources Administrator
description:
Key Responsibilities

1\. Payroll, HRMS \& Operational Efficiency

* **Manage and oversee payroll processes, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance.**
* Administer and maintain the HRMS, ensuring accurate employee records and effective utilization of HR technology.
* **Identify opportunities to streamline HR processes and improve operational efficiency.**  Coordinate with Finance and relevant stakeholders on payroll and employee\-related matters.
* **Maintain HR documentation, reports, and employee data with appropriate confidentiality.**

2\. Hiring \& Workforce Planning

* **Develop hiring plans aligned with business requirements and workforce budgets.**  Partner with management to understand current and future manpower requirements. **Manage the end\-to\-end recruitment process, including job descriptions, sourcing, screening, interviews, selection, and onboarding.**
* Monitor recruitment costs and ensure hiring activities remain aligned with approved budgets.
* **Support workforce planning and talent acquisition strategies.**

3\. HR Policy Development \& Alignment

* **Develop, review, and implement HR policies, procedures, and guidelines.**
* Ensure HR policies are aligned with organizational objectives and applicable employment requirements.
* **Communicate policies effectively to employees and managers.**  Periodically review policies and recommend improvements based on organizational needs and employee feedback.

4\. Employee Feedback, Check\-ins \& Engagement

* **Establish regular employee feedback and check\-in mechanisms.**
* Support employee relations and address workplace concerns professionally and confidentially.
* **Develop and coordinate employee engagement initiatives.**
* Monitor employee sentiment and identify areas requiring HR intervention.
* **Promote effective communication between employees and management.**

5\. KPI \& Performance Reviews

Coordinate and administer the employee performance management process.

* Develop and monitor KPIs in collaboration with managers and employees.
* Facilitate periodic performance reviews, goal setting, and performance discussions.
* Maintain performance records and ensure timely completion of review cycles.
* Support managers in identifying performance improvement and development opportunities.

Qualifications \& Education

* Master’s degree in Human Resources / Human Resource Management or a related field, with specialization in HR preferred.
* Relevant professional certifications in HR, payroll, or HR technology would be an advantage.
* Strong knowledge of HR operations, employee relations, recruitment, performance management, and HRMS.

Key Competencies

* HR Operations \& Administration
* Payroll \& HRMS Management
* Workforce Planning \& Budgeting
* Talent Acquisition
* HR Policy Development
* Employee Relations \& Engagement
* Performance \& KPI Management
* Communication \& Stakeholder Management
* Problem Solving and Process Improvement
* Confidentiality and Professional Ethics

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Cyber Security Site Lead
description:
### **Responsibilities**


**BU Cyber Lead**


**Cybersecurity Strategy and Leadership for Business Unit:**



Develop, implement, and oversee the business unit’s cybersecurity strategy in alignment with the organization’s overall security framework and business objectives.



Provide expert guidance and leadership on cybersecurity best practices to business unit leaders, ensuring security is a top priority across the business.



Foster a security\-conscious culture within the business unit, engaging employees and leaders at all levels to prioritize and adhere to cybersecurity standards.


**Risk Management and Threat Mitigation:**



Identify, assess, and manage cybersecurity risks specific to the business unit, including business\-critical applications, data, and infrastructure.



Work with business unit leadership to ensure that cybersecurity risks are adequately mitigated and aligned with business priorities and objectives.



Conduct regular risk assessments and vulnerability management exercises to ensure that the business unit is protected from emerging and ongoing cybersecurity threats.


**Collaboration with Cross\-Functional Teams:**



Partner with enterprise cybersecurity, IT, legal, and compliance teams to ensure that the business unit's cybersecurity practices are aligned with corporate security policies and regulatory requirements.



Collaborate with business unit teams to integrate security considerations into daily operations, product development, and IT systems.



Support business units in achieving their goals by ensuring that cybersecurity risks are understood and managed proactively during project planning and execution.


**Incident Response and Crisis Management:**



Act as the business unit's lead during cybersecurity incidents, coordinating response efforts and ensuring timely resolution of security breaches or vulnerabilities.



Lead post\-incident reviews to assess the impact, identify lessons learned, and ensure that future security measures are enhanced to prevent similar issues.



Work closely with the enterprise cybersecurity team to implement incident response protocols and communication strategies.


**Compliance and Regulatory Oversight:**



Ensure that the business unit adheres to relevant cybersecurity compliance requirements and industry standards (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001, NIST, etc.).



Manage and oversee internal and external audits to ensure compliance with regulatory bodies and industry\-specific cybersecurity standards.



Ensure the business unit's cybersecurity practices meet legal and regulatory requirements for data protection and security.


**Security Awareness and Training:**



Collaborate with the enterprise security team to ensure that the business unit's employees receive appropriate cybersecurity awareness training.



Develop and deliver tailored cybersecurity training and awareness programs that address the specific security challenges and needs of the business unit.



Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of security training, providing feedback and additional resources as necessary.


**Cybersecurity Program Management:**



Oversee and manage the execution of cybersecurity initiatives and projects within the business unit, ensuring they are completed on time and within budget.



Monitor and report on the progress of cybersecurity initiatives, tracking performance metrics and identifying any roadblocks or challenges that may arise.



Lead the adoption of cybersecurity tools, technologies, and processes within the business unit to improve security posture and risk mitigation.


**Reporting and Stakeholder Engagement:**



Provide regular updates and reports to senior leadership on the business unit's cybersecurity posture, risks, and ongoing initiatives.



Serve as the primary point of contact for cybersecurity\-related queries from business unit leadership, ensuring clear and timely communication.



Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders within the business unit to promote cybersecurity awareness and drive security initiatives forward.


**Key Stakeholders \- Internal**



Business Unit Heads and Department Heads



Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)



IT Infrastructure and Operations Teams



Information Security and IT teams



Legal, HR, and Compliance teams



Risk Management Teams



Audit Teams


**Key Stakeholders \- External**



Regulatory Authorities and Compliance Organizations



External Consultants



Security Vendors and Third\-Party Service Providers



External Security Solution Vendors


### **Qualifications**


**Educational Qualification:**



Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.



Advanced degree (e.g., Master's, MBA) in Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, or a relevant discipline is highly desirable.


**Certification:**



Relevant industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or CISA are a plus.



Solid understanding of cybersecurity risks, policies, and regulatory requirements (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR).


**Work Experience (Range of years):**



18 \- 25 years with at least 8 years in Cyber Security.

title: Senior Technical Consultant, HRSD / GBS ServiceNow - (Global role)
description:

Atos also provides consulting and advisory services through its Atos Amplify brand.  

A trusted partner in operating complex and mission\-critical environments, Atos supports organizations across highly regulated and sovereign contexts.

Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 54,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7\.2 billion, operating in 54 countries under two brands \- Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI\-powered, end\-to\-end solutions for all industries. ### **Senior Technical Consultant – ServiceNow HRSD / GBS (Global Role)**

This is a strategic, customer\-facing role focused on designing and delivering enterprise\-scale HRSD solutions, AI\-powered employee experiences, intelligent workflows, and shared\-service transformation initiatives for global organizations.



Working closely with CTO leadership, Solution Architects, Enterprise Architects, and global delivery teams, you will help shape next\-generation ServiceNow offerings while driving complex digital transformation programs across multiple geographies.

###

* Configure and implement HRSD capabilities including:
	+ HR Case \& Knowledge Management
	+ Employee Center / Employee Center Pro
	+ Enterprise Onboarding \& Transitions
	+ Lifecycle Events
	+ Universal Request
	+ Virtual Agent
* Design scalable employee journeys and shared\-service workflows supporting global operations.
* Develop integrations with HRIS, payroll, identity, document management, and enterprise platforms.
* Collaborate with HR, GBS, legal, privacy, compliance, security, and executive stakeholders.
* Provide technical design guidance, solution governance, best practices, and architectural recommendations.
* Drive automation, AI\-enabled experiences, reusable accelerators, and continuous platform innovation.
* Mentor technical teams and support pre\-sales, solution shaping, and customer workshops.


### **Required Qualifications**

* 8\+ years of enterprise application or HR technology experience.

* Strong experience with:
	+ Flow Designer

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, or other HR platforms.

### **Why Join Us?**


* Work on **global transformation programs** and strategic ServiceNow initiatives.
* Partner closely with senior leadership and CTO\-led innovation teams.
* Deliver **AI\-powered employee experience solutions** for enterprise customers worldwide.
* Influence the future of our global ServiceNow HRSD and GBS consulting practice.
